visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with long, straight brown hair and a friendly expression. She wears a white blouse with a black pleated bodice. She holds two egg tarts—one classic and one with a scorched top—toward the camera. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall with soft lighting. (2) In the next phase, she brings the classic egg tart, held in its yellow paper liner, to her mouth and takes a large bite. Her eyes are closed, and her facial expression suggests extreme delight and satisfaction. The pastry appears golden and flaky with a smooth custard center. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor setting during daylight. The woman stands in front of a white, red, and blue Mister Softee truck. She holds a vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone in a red wafer. She smiles playfully at the camera while urban street elements are visible behind her. (4) The setting transitions to a brightly lit restaurant. The woman uses black chopsticks to lift vermicelli and scallions from a large steamed scallop shell. She eats the food with wide eyes and an enthusiastic expression. Other diners and wooden restaurant furniture are visible in the background. (5) Finally, she is seen eating a bowl of purple dessert soup (likely red bean) with a white ceramic spoon. She chews with visible enjoyment, then looks directly into the lens, winks, and gives a clear thumbs-up gesture to indicate her approval of the meal.
